[Delete Guild]
Only the guild leader has the authority to delete the guild. Before deleting the guild, all other members in the guild need to be kicked out.

\
uniform vec2 sp_size;                                                                        
\
uniform vec2 mask_size;                                                                      
\
uniform vec2 v_offset;                                                                       
\
uniform float u_enable;

\
uniform sampler2D u_texture;                                                                 
\

void main() {                                                                                
\
    vec2 texCoord = v_texCoord;                                                              
\
    vec2 pos = vec2(texCoord.x*sp_size.x, texCoord.y*sp_size.y);                             
\
    vec2 offset = vec2(pos.x - v_offset.x, pos.y - v_offset.y);                              
\
                                                                                             
\
    if(offset.x <= mask_size.x && offset.x >= 0.0 && offset.y <= mask_size.y && offset.y >= 0.0) 
\
    {                                                                                        
\
        vec2 finCoord = vec2(offset.x/mask_size.x, offset.y/mask_size.y);                    
\
        vec4 mask_FragColor = texture2D(u_mask_texture, finCoord);                           
\
                                                                                             
\
        vec4 texColor = texture2D(u_texture, v_texCoord);                                    
\
        gl_FragColor = v_fragmentColor*texColor;                                             
\
        gl_FragColor.a = (1.0-mask_FragColor.a*u_enable) * texColor.a;                                
\
